'''''Emperor of Air and Darkness''''' was an album by the band [[Deeply Religious]]. It was banned by the [[Imperial Board of Culture]].

==Track listing==
*"[[Ancient Republic]]"
*"[[Lost Promise]]"
*"[[Moff Balfour's Lament (Tapmint Surprise)]]"
*"[[Speeder Bike Races (Speed Kills)]]"

==Behind the scenes==
"Queen of Air and Darkness" is also used in-universe as a card in [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].
